title: The Sunflowers

intro.speaker: elias
intro.text: Do you remember the seeds we sowed in the winter? Look at them now: sunflowers, taller than me!

intro.speaker: elias
intro.text: Let's measure them with the blocks, and see which grew tallest.

steps.speaker: elias
steps.prompt: Stack blocks beside each sunflower until the stack is just as tall.
steps.question: tallest

older.question: difference
older.prompt: Measure each sunflower with the blocks. How much taller is the tallest than the shortest?

feedback.all_good: Now we know! Each one turned its face to the sun, and grew.

outro.speaker: elias
outro.text: From a seed you could hide in your fingernail, to this! Every summer it amazes me.

journal_line: I measured the sunflowers at the monastery with Brother Elias.
